title: AnalysisReport
description: v0.6 (adds, additively: program `sql`, the embedded-SQL facts: tables with their schema source, statements classified into the verified subset, cursors, and the exact refusal reason when anything is outside it; a program using only the subset is convertible and the verifier compares its files, stdout and the final contents of every table it touched on a stand-in engine, never real DB2). v0.5 (adds, additively: file direction `io` for sequential files opened I-O, program `displayOnly` for programs whose only observable output is DISPLAY/RETURN-CODE, program `resolvedCalls` for CALL identifier targets resolved statically; the analyzer marks such programs convertible only because services/verifier compares them -- see verification-report v0.8). v0.4 (v0.2 added organization and clock, collation, float and source findings; v0.3 adds field usage, all sign modes, P scaling, OCCURS, REDEFINES and record formats; v0.4 adds job-level conversion: `jobs[]` groups JCL steps by job, classifies each step, parses SORT FIELDS=, wires step-to-step DD/DSN flow and says whether the whole job converts -- v1 scope only: one SORT step then one COBOL step). Output of services/analyzer for one source repository: programs, their files and record layouts derived from copybooks, JCL jobs, dependencies and risk findings.

path.description: Source path relative to the repository root

copybookPaths.description: Member name -> path in the repository where the analyzer found it (library members have no extension)

modules.description: Source paths of programs it CALLs (transitively), compiled and verified with it

job.description: JCL member that runs this program, if found

dd.description: DD name from SELECT ... ASSIGN TO

direction.description: io: a sequential file opened I-O and updated in place (REWRITE); the verifier seeds it from generated records and compares its final contents

dsn.description: Dataset name from the JCL DD statement

organization.description: SEQUENTIAL, LINE SEQUENTIAL, RECORD SEQUENTIAL, INDEXED or RELATIVE

displayOnly.description: Additive (v0.5). True when the program has no output or I-O file and its observable result is its DISPLAY output and RETURN-CODE; the verifier compares stdout and exit code. Absent or false otherwise.

resolvedCalls.description: Additive (v0.5). CALL identifier -> the literal program name it can only ever hold (VALUE clause and literal MOVEs; nothing else assigns it). Those programs are in `modules` like any static CALL.

convertible.description: True when Diocle can run it end to end with supported layouts: either one input and one output file, several input/output/io files, or (displayOnly) stdout and exit code

findings.description: Legacy behaviour a conversion must preserve.

jobs.description: JCL jobs, grouped from the flat step list by (job, member) in source/EXEC order. v1 scope: a job is convertible only if it is exactly one SORT step followed by one COBOL step, with the SORT step's output DD's DSN matching one of the COBOL step's input DD DSNs; anything else (3+ steps, COND-gated/PROC-conditional steps, multiple SORT steps, unsupported SORT control syntax, GDG generation arithmetic beyond an exact-DSN match) is refused with a specific reason.

member.description: JCL member the job came from, repository-relative

proc.description: Cataloged procedure this step came from, if any

kind.description: cobol: program matches a parsed entry in programs[]; sort: a SORT/SYNCSORT/DFSORT utility step; other: anything else (COBOL step whose source was not found, IDCAMS, IEBGENER, ...)

sort.description: Parsed SORT control statement; null for non-SORT steps.

fields.description: Fixed-offset sort keys: [start, length, format, order], 1-based start as written in FIELDS=.

unsupported.description: Specific SORT syntax this analysis does not support yet (INCLUDE/OMIT COND=, OUTREC/INREC, SUM FIELDS=, MERGE, a key format other than CH (ZD/PD/BI are refused), or SYSIN not resolvable), or null when the control statement parsed cleanly

convertibleProgram.description: The matching programs[] entry's own convertible value, for a cobol step; null for sort/other steps

notConvertibleReason.description: Why this step on its own is not convertible (program's notConvertibleReason, a SORT unsupported reason, or that the program was not found); null when the step is fine on its own

wiring.description: Every DSN written by one step and read by a later step in the same job (GDG relative-generation qualifiers normalized away before comparing).

dsn.description: Producer's DSN as written (before GDG normalization)

sql.description: Additive (v0.6). Present when the program has EXEC SQL. `refusal` is null only when every statement is inside the verified subset (see services/analyzer/diocle_analyzer/sqlsubset.py and the README); otherwise it is the exact reason and the program is not convertible. Tables come from EXEC SQL DECLARE TABLE (in the program or an INCLUDEd DCLGEN copybook) or from CREATE TABLE in *.sql files of the repository; with none the program is refused, a schema is never guessed.

source.description: declare: DECLARE TABLE in the program; dclgen: in an INCLUDEd copybook; ddl: CREATE TABLE in a *.sql file.

path.description: Repository path of the copybook or DDL file; null for DECLARE TABLE in the program itself.

reason.description: Why the statement is outside the subset.

layout.description: Fixed-width record layout, same shape as samples/*/sample.json layouts. Null when the copybook uses features the layout model does not support.

format.description: line: one record per text line (LINE SEQUENTIAL); fixed: fixed-length byte records with no separators (SEQUENTIAL, RECFM=FB)

scale.description: Decimal digits; negative for P scaling (PIC 9(3)PP has scale -2)

sign.description: trailing/leading: overpunch, the sign carried in the last/first digit

usage.description: display (default), packed = COMP-3, binary = COMP/COMP-4/BINARY (big-endian), binary-native = COMP-5, float = COMP-1/COMP-2

bytes.description: Storage size for float fields (4 or 8)

redefines.description: Not a stored field: an alternative view of the bytes of this field
